Marking Roborock's 12th anniversary, the high-tech cleaning company is rolling out a host of promotions from now through September 6, with generous discounts available on a range of its robotic vacuum cleaners and other products.

The anniversary deals cover products and bundles with discounts ranging from 25% to over 50%, with savings of up to $1,600……

Saros 20

The Saros 20 pictured above is Roborock's flagship smart robotic vacuum, featuring unprecedented real-world intelligence, purpose-built for the larger, more complex homes found across North America. Key features include the StarSight Autonomous System 2.0, AdaptiLift Chassis 3.0, the Carpet Intelligence System, and Smart Plan 3.0.

StarSight is the most advanced autonomous navigation system on the market, combining dual-emitter solid-state LiDAR with 3D time-of-flight technology to map your home in extraordinarily fine 3D detail. It can accurately identify and avoid more than 300 different types of obstacles, from stray cables to pets.

The AdaptiLift Chassis is an advanced system that recognises door thresholds and steps, then uses motorized legs to automatically lift the Saros 20 over them, delivering uninterrupted whole-home cleaning. Meanwhile, the Carpet Intelligence System automatically adjusts the vacuum's body height to maintain optimal suction, ensuring deep cleaning on carpets with piles up to 3cm.

Smart Plan 2.0 is an AI-driven intelligent cleaning system that analyses your home's unique layout, flooring materials, and the daily habits of all household members, automatically optimising the cleaning routine accordingly.

Qrevo 2 Pro

Making its debut in the United States, the all-new Qrevo 2 Pro is the ultimate robotic vacuum for pet owners. Engineered to tackle stubborn stains and pet hair, it features a dual zero-tangle system paired with 20,000 Pa of suction, delivering 100% effective hair removal with zero tangles. The robotic vacuum effortlessly handles pet fur, cat litter, cereal crumbs, and muddy paw prints.

The most challenging scenario is one with both pets and high-pile carpets. The Qrevo Pro 2 handles this effortlessly with its auto mop-detaching function: when returning to dock, it leaves the mop pads at the base, ensuring carpets stay completely dry.

F25 Steam

The F25 Steam is the ultimate handheld wet-and-dry cleaner, combining 25,000 Pa suction with 356°F VaporFlow steam cleaning.

Key features include 80 minutes of battery life enough to clean an entire home, a 180-degree lay-flat design that reaches under furniture, blue light illumination to reveal hidden dust, and fully automatic steam self-cleaning with hot-air drying upon completion.

F25 XT

For those who want powerful wet-and-dry cleaning without steam, the F25 XT delivers 20,000 Pa of suction and features SlideTech 2.0 wheels for a smoother, easier clean.

The F25 XT offers true edge-to-edge wet-and-dry cleaning, leaving surfaces spotless in a single pass. The JawScrapers roller features a shark-tooth blade anti-tangle brush head that captures hair thoroughly, while the continuous-press squeegee strip leaves floors completely streak-free with a flawless finish. Like the F25 Steam, it uses a 180-degree lay-flat design and delivers up to 60 minutes of battery life in energy-saving mode — enough to continuously clean spaces up to 4,400 square feet without recharging.

More Deals

The Qrevo S Pro and two of the company's most popular bundles are also heavily discounted:

  • Qrevo S Pro: Originally $699.99, now $429.99, saving $270 (38% off)
  • Saros 20 + F25GT Bundle: Originally $1,899.99, now $1,269.98, saving $630 (33% off)
  • Qrevo S Pro + F25GT Bundle: Originally $999.98, now $549.98, saving $450 (45% off)

All promotional pricing ends September 6, so act soon to take advantage of these offers.
